name: manual_cbb2e0
claim: A test harness that extracts PowerShell functions into a child process must also extract every helper those functions call, and tests skipped on non-Windows CI must be run on a Windows host before calling the PR green

decisions.notes: 2026-10-25: orama efe78b56 made Topo-WriteProbeOutput call Topo-MaskSecrets but the probe-return harness did not load it; the test fails on Windows and is skipped on Linux CI, so CI stayed green (fixed in 1f1bd8ce)
